parsed.post: Significant jump! Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 improved val_bpb from 1.0448 to 1.0115. The model has more capacity and handles the training better. Next, I'll try to refine the learning rate to see if we can squeeze more out of this higher capacity architecture.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 and lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.02 to stabilize the higher capacity model.
